Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a standard AP-MS workflow to identify protein-protein interactions between SETD3 and enterovirus 2A. Acquisition is DDA (TopN) on a Q-Exactive Plus. Quantification is performed via LFQ (spectral counting and intensity).

scope: Affinity purification mass spectrometry (AP-MS) has proven a powerful tool for identifying protein-protein interactions (PPIs)
For SETD3 affinity purifications (APs) in the presence and absence of CV-B3 2A protease, we transfected the cells with a single FLAG-tagged plenti-CMV-SETD3 construct
The lysate was incubated with 30 µl equilibrated anti-FLAG M2 Affinity Gel beads (Sigma-Aldrich) for 2 h at 4 °C.
For mass spectrometry (MS) analysis the AP eluates were reduced with 1 mM DTT at 37 °C for 30 min
Sequential purifications followed the procedure for single-step FLAG AP (described above) followed by a Strep AP.
Eluates were neutralised with 1 M Tris pH 9.0 and subjected to trypsin digestion followed by desalting as described above for the single-step FLAG-based AP

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on material obtained via single and sequential affinity purifications (FLAG and Strep tags) to isolate the SETD3-2A complex from cell lysates.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment uses AP-MS to compare the interactome of SETD3 in the presence vs absence of the viral protease 2A, and between WT SETD3 and various SETD3 mutants. CV-B3 2A is treated as a ligand/stimulation variable as it is an exogenous viral protein used to perturb the host protein complex.
